subject: Re: Accelerating evaluation — MAP milestones, pricing protection, and close timeline
messages:
From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acme.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: Taylor Nguyen <t.nguyen@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Initial ask — can we compress the MAP and lock price protection?

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team is excited. We have a compressed evaluation window (we need production readiness by mid-October) and procurement asked for a clear mutual action plan with milestones tied to pricing/commit levels. Two procurement asks: 1) a firm definition of "usage" (do you count tokens, requests, or both?) and 2) a price-protection clause for the first 12 months that prevents upward changes mid-term.

Can you share a sample MAP and the commercial mechanics (discounts at commit thresholds, true-up cadence)? Also please confirm a realistic close timeline if we accept the MAP today.

-Jordan
Procurement: Taylor Nguyen (cc)

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acme.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial ask — can we compress the MAP and lock price protection?

Jordan — great to hear this is moving fast. Attached is a short MAP template that highlights milestones (pilot kickoff, weekly evaluative checkpoints, performance acceptance, ramp to committed capacity). High-level answers inline: 

- Usage definition: by default we define usage as billable tokens (input + output) for text generations; embeddings are measured per vector. We can add an API-call metric if you prefer, but discounts and commits are token-based.
- Pricing protection: we can offer a fixed-rate protection for the first 12 months from contract effective date, with a carve-out for material changes to cloud provider GPU costs.
- True-up cadence: quarterly true-ups are standard; we can compress to 60-day true-ups during the initial 6-month ramp if that helps procurement.

Proposed close timeline if we agree to the MAP today: 1) Legal redline within 3 business days, 2) Procurement signature within 5 business days, 3) Pilot kickoff within 7 business days after signature — which would meet your mid-October target.

I've looped in Marcus to confirm pricing bands and any concession room. Attached: [Attachment: 20260820-acme-map-draft.pdf (PDF)].

—Laura Bennett
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acme.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 11:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial ask — can we compress the MAP and lock price protection?

Jordan / Laura — quick commercial note from me. We can offer the following sliding schedule tied to committed monthly token volumes (MTV):

- Tier 1: 0–500M tokens/mo — list rates (no discount)
- Tier 2: 500M–2B tokens/mo — 18% discount at contract signature; applies when monthly committed baseline hit
- Tier 3: >2B tokens/mo — 30% discount with 6-month committed ramp and a waterfall true-up (see attachment)

For price protection, we can guarantee the agreed unit price for 12 months, with a capped inflation adjustment (index-based) only in the event of sustained cloud GPU price increases >15% YoY. Regarding true-ups: we recommend a staged waterfall so sudden spikes don't create large retro invoices — 60d lookback then a capped reconciliation at each milestone.

Attaching a concise pricing summary for your procurement team: [Attachment: 20260824-pricing_summary.pdf (PDF)].

If procurement insists on absolute price immutability we can explore an upfront reserve (longer commit term) — I can run numbers if you'd like.

—Marcus Lin
Head of Sales, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial ask — can we compress the MAP and lock price protection?

Laura / Marcus — thanks for the clarity. A couple of procurement redline requests before we move to legal redlines: 

1) Definition ask: we need to define "usage" as API calls for our budget tooling; tokens are hard to reconcile on our finance side. Can you provide a firm equivalence (tokens per call) or make pricing callable-based?
2) Price protection ask: procurement will accept a 12-month price guarantee only if there is no mid-term upward adjustment, full stop (cloud cost carve-outs will be a blocker).

We'd be willing to accept a staged ramp (90 days) with a simple true-up at the end of each quarter. If you can concede on the price-protection language (no carve-outs), we can push legal to turn quickly.

—Acme Procurement (Taylor Nguyen)

From: sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acme.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 08:31:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial ask — can we compress the MAP and lock price protection?

Jordan / team — thanks for the procurement notes. Draft legal compromise below (high level):

- Usage: We'll include a primary billing metric of billable tokens. Appendix A will contain an "API-call equivalence table" to help Acme map calls → token expectations for budgeting; equivalence will be an estimate and not a pricing driver.
- Price protection: Redwood will provide a 12-month firm unit price from effective date. We will not include a general cloud-cost carve-out; instead, we propose a narrowly scoped clause that allows adjustment only in the event of demonstrable, extraordinary changes to third-party base compute costs, with a 30-day notice and a cap of 7% annually.
- True-ups: For the first 6 months we will do 60-day recon, then quarterly thereafter. Reconciliations will be capped at the greater of 10% of monthly committed volume or $25k to avoid large retro invoices.

If Acme can accept the narrow adjustment mechanism and the capped reconciliation, legal can prepare a redline for signature in 48–72 hours. If your side requires absolute immutability, we will need to move to a longer-term commitment with an upfront financial reserve.

Quoted for context: "On Tue, 24 Aug 2026 11:48:00 -0700 marcus_lin@redwood.ai wrote: > For price protection, we can guarantee the agreed unit price for 12 months..."

—Sergio Alvarez
Director, Solutions & Contracts
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acme.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial ask — can we compress the MAP and lock price protection?

Laura / Sergio / Marcus — thank you — the compromise on limited adjustment plus a 7% cap and the capped reconciliation sounds reasonable. Procurement will accept the narrow carve-out if Redwood includes the API-call equivalence appendix for our internal chargeback system. We'll ask legal to push the redline back to you by EOD Wed (Aug 2) and aim to sign by the 10th.

Next steps we expect:
- Redwood legal redline ready within 48 hours once you confirm Appendix A format
- Acme legal redline back by Wed EOD
- Target signature: 2026-09-10
- Pilot kickoff: within 5 business days of signature

Please include a DocuSign link in the final package and a clean copy of the MAP.

Attachments noted on our side: [Acme preliminary terms spreadsheet attached internally].

—Jordan Ellis
Senior Product Manager, Acme Corp
